crossRefs.note: He went up into the mountain, and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.
He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach,
He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal…
When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:
He called the twelve together, and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.
Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.
Yahweh’s anger burned against Moses, and he said, “What about Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak…
You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach…
Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another…
I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in…
These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;
The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”

translations.web: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus called the Twelve to Him and began to send them out two by two, giving them authority over unclean spirits.
translations.kjv: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
translations.asv: And he calleth unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits;
